'''Estaria''' was an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] situated in the [[Indrexu sector/Legends|Indrexu sector]] on the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]]. It was a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] world and during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] housed [[Estaria Central Starport]], which regulated [[Starship/Legends|starship]] travel in the entire [[Estaria system/Legends|Estaria system]].

==Description==
Estaria<ref name="Xim Week" /> was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Hideouts" /> that was located within the [[Estaria system/Legends|Estaria system]], a part of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']]<ref name="EAOC" /> [[Indrexu sector/Legends|Indrexu sector]]. Situated in the historical [[Greater Tion]] region, Estaria was connected to the planets [[Ank Ki'Shor]] and [[Makem Te/Legends|Makem Te]] by the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]]<ref name="Xim Week" /> [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|super-hyperroute]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>&mdash;which served as the dividing line between [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] and the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]]<ref name="Regions" />&mdash;while the [[Tion Trade Route]] linked it to the world of [[Endregaad]].<ref name="Xim Week" />

==Inhabitants==
Estaria served as the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the Indrexu [[Sector/Legends|sector]]. It was a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] world that serviced the [[Starship/Legends|starships]] traveling between the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]] and the worlds of the [[Far Perlemian]] region, and it was only moderately corrupt by Tion Cluster standards.<ref name="Xim Week" />

==Locations==
{{Main|Estaria Central Starport}}
[[File:EstariaCentralStarportMainLevel-HideoutsAndStrongholds.png|thumb|right|300px|Map of the main level of Estaria Central Starport]]
Several [[City/Legends|cities]] were located on Estaria, including a town housing [[Estaria Central Starport]]. The spaceport's [[Control tower/Legends|control tower]] served as the central authority for all starships in both the facility's vicinity and in the planet's [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]]. All craft landing at or launching from the spaceport, as well as those traveling through the Estaria [[Star system/Legends|system]], were required to maintain contact with the tower at all [[Time/Legends|times]].<ref name="Hideouts" />

Most of the larger passenger travel companies using Estaria Central Starport only sent loading [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttles]] to and from the spaceport's [[Hangar/Legends|landing bays]], while their main passenger ships remained in the planet's orbit. Inside the spaceport itself, planetary travel services agencies provided information on any of Estaria's cities as well as passenger and cargo companies serving the corresponding regions of the planet.<ref name="Hideouts" />

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Estaria Central Starport had a small [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] presence. It was also the site of a [[Estaria Cache|Rebel Alliance supply cache]], which was spread among the spaceport's many transient lockers and within its system of cargo warehouses. The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] cell that maintained the cache included the spaceport's [[Administrator/Legends|Freight Administrator]] [[Ela Harns]], the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Chief Technician]] [[Ablee Bansak]], and the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Supervisor/Legends|Cargo Supervisor]] [[Hev Lissona]].<ref name="Hideouts" />

==Behind the scenes==
Estaria was introduced in the [[1998]] sourcebook ''[[Hideouts & Strongholds]]'', written by [[Sterling Hershey]] for use with [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''. Although the planet was left unnamed in ''Hideouts & Strongholds'', the book did introduce the name "Estaria Central Starport."<ref name="Hideouts" /> Estaria itself was first named by<ref name="Xim Week" /> the [[December 7]], [[2009]] [[StarWars.com]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]]<ref name="XimOriginal">{{SWArchive|url=fans/hyperspace/source/ximweek01/index.html|text=Xim Week: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster|int=Xim Week: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster}}</ref> article "[[Xim Week: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster]]" by [[Jason Fry]], which placed Estaria in grid square S-5.<ref name="Xim Week" />
